claude_visibility.prompt: What are the best knowledge base software platforms in 2026?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: The best knowledge base software in 2026 depends on your use case, but here are the top platforms I'd recommend: 1. Notion — Extremely popular for internal wikis and team knowledge, flexible, with strong AI features and databases. 2. Confluence (Atlassian) — The enterprise standard for internal documentation.

claude_visibility.prompt: What are the best alternatives to Confluence for team documentation?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: Great question! Confluence is powerful but can feel heavy or expensive for many teams. Here are the best alternatives depending on your needs: 1) Notion — the most popular all-in-one workspace, flexible docs, wikis, and databases with a gentle learning curve. 2) Slite — clean, purpose-built for team knowledge and docs. 3) GitBook — excellent for technical and developer documentation.

claude_visibility.prompt: What is the best AI-powered documentation platform?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: The best AI-powered documentation platform depends on your use case, but here are the top options: 1. Mintlify — A modern, developer-focused documentation platform with strong AI features, beautiful default design, and AI-powered search/chat. 2. Document360 — A robust knowledge base platform with AI features.

claude_visibility.prompt: What software is best for building a customer-facing help center or knowledge base?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: The best software for building a customer-facing help center or knowledge base depends on your needs, but here are my top recommendations: 1. Zendesk Guide — Part of the Zendesk suite, excellent if you already use Zendesk for support. 2. Intercom — Strong for SaaS companies, combines knowledge base with live chat.

claude_visibility.prompt: What are the best tools for an internal company knowledge base?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: The best tools for an internal company knowledge base depend on your team's needs, but here are the top options I'd recommend: 1. Confluence (Atlassian) — The most widely used enterprise wiki, especially strong if you already use Jira. 2. Notion — Extremely flexible, combining docs, wikis, databases, and project management.

claude_visibility.prompt: What are the best Document360 alternatives?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: The best Document360 alternatives depend on your use case, but here are the top options: 1. GitBook — Excellent for developer-focused and technical documentation with a clean, modern interface and strong Git integration. 2. Confluence — Atlassian's powerful choice for internal knowledge bases and team collaboration.

claude_visibility.prompt: What is the best knowledge base software with approval workflows, versioning and audit trails for regulated industries?
claude_visibility.answer_snippet: For regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, finance, etc.) needing approval workflows, versioning, and audit trails in a knowledge base, here are the tools I'd recommend: 1. Document360 — Strong choice for regulated environments, with category-level workflows, article versioning with rollback, approval/review workflows, and detailed audit logs.

recommendations.title: Ship a public Document360 MCP server and list it in MCP registries
recommendations.detail: Stand up an official Document360 MCP server this week that lets ChatGPT, Claude, and agents query a customer's KB and public docs, then submit it to public MCP registries and the Anthropic/OpenAI connector directories. Mintlify already runs a public MCP server and GitBook ships one-click MCP connectors; matching them is table stakes for being the docs source AI agents pull from, and directly feeds LLM answer citation.
recommendations.evidence: Mintlify Index + public MCP server and GitBook one-click MCP connectors named in competitor momentum; AI/LLM answer presence flagged as new priority.

recommendations.title: Publish llms.txt and llms-full.txt across document360.com and all customer help centres
recommendations.detail: Add /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt to the marketing site and expose an auto-generated llms.txt for every hosted help centre so LLM crawlers get clean, structured summaries of product and customer docs. This is a low-effort, start-this-week change that improves how reliably ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI Overview parse and cite Document360 content, and becomes a sellable feature for customers who want their own docs surfaced in AI answers.
recommendations.evidence: AI/LLM visibility is the stated new priority; median position 3 with room to move up despite 6/7 prompt presence.

recommendations.title: Publish an annual 'State of Knowledge Management' original-research report with a citable data set
recommendations.detail: Commission and publish a benchmark report (survey + product-usage aggregates) with a stable landing page, downloadable data, and per-stat anchor links so LLMs and journalists cite Document360 as the source. GitBook's State of Documentation Report and the Mintlify Index are already winning original-research cadence and getting cited; owning KM/help-centre metrics (not just dev docs) is our differentiated lane.
recommendations.evidence: GitBook State of Documentation Report and Mintlify Index cited in competitor momentum; original research listed as a D360 exposure.

recommendations.title: Build answer-first 'Document360 vs [competitor]' comparison pages with FAQ/comparison schema
recommendations.detail: Publish neutral, spec-table comparison pages for Confluence, GitBook, Guru, Archbee, and ProProfs with an answer-first opening paragraph and FAQPage/Product schema so they win share-of-search on 'alternatives to X' and get lifted into AI Overviews. This reclaims ground ProProfs is taking with its 'Best Document360 Alternatives' page ranking itself #1 — without repeating its biased claims, we simply own accurate, structured comparisons.
recommendations.evidence: ProProfs runs an SEO 'Best Document360 Alternatives' attack page ranking #1; 'alternatives to X' share-of-search listed as a D360 exposure.

recommendations.title: Launch a regulated-buyer governance page countering the Rovo AI data-exfiltration disclosure
recommendations.detail: Create a 'Secure AI knowledge for regulated teams' page and sales one-pager centred on Document360's approvals, versioning, and audit trails, and how our AI is scoped to prevent prompt-injection data leakage. This capitalizes on the Aug 2026 Varonis/PromptArmor disclosure that Rovo can be tricked into exfiltrating Jira/Confluence data — frame it factually around the public source, never as an attack.
recommendations.evidence: Confluence/Atlassian Rovo AI exfiltration of Jira/Confluence data, public Varonis/PromptArmor disclosure Aug 2026 (thehackernews.com); governance is a stated D360 win.

recommendations.title: Arm sales with a Guru TCO battlecard on unlimited knowledge consumers
recommendations.detail: Ship a Sales Enablement battlecard and interactive ROI calculator showing total cost when Guru charges a paid seat per read-only knowledge consumer versus Document360's reader model. Guru's per-read-seat internal pricing penalizes exactly the large-audience internal KB deployments we win, so quantify the delta at 100/500/1000 readers for AEs to use in live deals.
recommendations.evidence: Guru per-read-seat internal pricing — every knowledge consumer needs a paid seat (verified opening).

recommendations.title: Refresh G2/Capterra/TrustRadius presence and seed a review-generation push
recommendations.detail: Run a customer-marketing campaign to add 30-50 fresh reviews across G2, Capterra, and TrustRadius this quarter and keep category-comparison profiles current, because LLMs and AI Overviews heavily cite these review aggregators when answering 'best knowledge base' questions. Prioritize categories where D360 appears in only 6/7 prompts to lift both appearance count and sentiment.
recommendations.evidence: Review-site presence and AI/LLM answer sentiment named as levers; d360_present_count 6 of 7 prompts with median position 3.

recommendations.title: Position Document360 as the governed, trustworthy source for AI agents and assistants
recommendations.detail: Publish messaging and a product page framing Document360 as the governed knowledge layer that feeds AI agents accurate, approved, audited content — approvals, versioning, and audit trails as the guardrails LLMs need. Glean ($300M ARR, Gartner 'Market Shaper') is reframing the category around agents; rather than out-fund an enterprise-search agent platform, compete on being the trusted, well-governed source those agents cite.
recommendations.evidence: Glean $300M ARR, Gartner 'Market Shaper' reframing category around agents; governance/audit trails are stated D360 wins.

recommendations.title: Publish an 'AI content maintenance & stale-content detection' feature page targeting ProProfs gaps
recommendations.detail: Create a capability page and demo GIF showing Document360's AI-driven content maintenance and stale/outdated-content detection, with FAQ schema so it surfaces in AI answers about KB upkeep. Third-party reviews flag that ProProfs has no AI content maintenance and no stale-content detection — we highlight our own capability factually rather than naming or attacking them.
recommendations.evidence: ProProfs KB third-party reviews flag no AI content maintenance and no stale-content detection (verified opening).

recommendations.title: Lead with 'AI included, no add-on' pricing messaging against Archbee
recommendations.detail: Update pricing and comparison assets to make clear Document360's AI assistant and in-app widget are included at plan level, with a landed-cost example. Archbee gates its AI assistant behind a paid add-on with real landed cost ~$180-230/mo once AI and the in-app widget are added, so a transparent all-in cost comparison wins price-sensitive AI-first buyers.
recommendations.evidence: Archbee AI assistant gated behind a paid add-on; real landed cost ~$180-230/mo with AI + widget (verified opening).

recommendations.title: Ship answer-engine-optimized FAQ and glossary hubs for the 7 tracked KB buyer intents
recommendations.detail: Map the 7 measured LLM prompts to dedicated FAQ and glossary pages with concise, quotable answer blocks and FAQPage schema, so Document360 becomes the cited passage rather than a mention. With brand score 86% but median position only 3, tighter, extractable answer content is the fastest lever to move D360 above Confluence and GitBook (each also at 6 appearances).
recommendations.evidence: claude_brand_score_pct 86, median_position 3; Confluence and GitBook tie D360 at 6 brand appearances.

recommendations.title: Harden Document360's entity footprint: schema.org markup, Wikidata, and a canonical facts page
recommendations.detail: Add Organization/SoftwareApplication schema across the site, create a canonical 'About Document360' facts page, and ensure accurate Wikidata/Crunchbase entries so LLMs ground the brand entity correctly and attribute capabilities to us. This strengthens grounding behind every AI answer and closes the developer-first brand-awareness gap without paid campaigns.
recommendations.evidence: Developer-first brand awareness and AI/LLM presence listed as D360 exposures; entity grounding underpins citation reliability.

recommendations.title: Publish a mixed-authorship 'one platform, one price' page countering per-author pricing models
recommendations.detail: Create a positioning page and calculator showing Document360's cost as editor teams grow, versus ProProfs' per-author pricing that scales with every editor. This targets our core strength — mixed authorship across customer-facing and internal knowledge on one platform — and gives AEs a concrete cost story for teams with many occasional contributors.
recommendations.evidence: ProProfs per-author pricing scales with every editor (verified opening); mixed authorship is a stated D360 win.

recommendations.title: Reframe developer-docs positioning around governance instead of out-funding Mintlify
recommendations.detail: Rather than competing head-to-head with Mintlify's $45M-backed developer-docs land grab, publish content and sales messaging for teams needing API docs plus governed customer-facing and internal knowledge on one platform with approvals and audit trails. Concede the pure developer-brand race where Mintlify is stronger and steer buyers to the multi-audience, enterprise-governance ground we own without enterprise-only pricing.
recommendations.evidence: Mintlify $45M Series B ($500M val, a16z/Salesforce) developer-docs land grab; D360 wins on governance and one platform for customer-facing + internal.

recommendations.title: Pursue analyst, awards, and event-stage placements to boost third-party citation supply
recommendations.detail: Submit for G2 category badges, relevant industry awards, and analyst briefings (Gartner/Forrester KM and DXP coverage), and secure at least two speaking slots this quarter, since these third-party sources feed both buyer trust and the corpus LLMs cite. Atlassian's Team'26 stage dominance and Glean's Gartner 'Market Shaper' status show competitors are converting analyst/event presence into category authority.
recommendations.evidence: Analyst/awards presence and event stage time listed as D360 exposures; Atlassian Team'26 and Glean Gartner 'Market Shaper' cited in momentum.
